therefore, i warmly urge everyone to rediscover and promote this practice. have you considered a vocation to the priesthood? you are welcome to a vocations holy hour in st cianán’s church, duleek on friday 23 october at 7pm live from facebook page: diocese of meath vocations check out instagram : dioceseofmeathvocations contact fr tony gonoude tel:

amen. child safeguarding sunday today we would like to recognise the children and young people who take part in our parish activities and hope they will continue to be part of our parish life.

these activities include the following: altar servers junior readers “light and life ” movement (teenagers) children’s gospel stories (starting 18 oct) children taking part in parish classes for first holy communion children participating in first holy communion and confirmation preparation masses thanks to our parish volunteers and to the parents who support our young people.
your enthusiasm, care and welcome plays a huge part in ensuring that children and young people have a positive experience in our parish.
thanks to our parish safeguarding representatives – cathy shelley, shaun mcgale and louise cotter.
we thank them for their oversight, support and encouragement.
